name: PRERANA Portal Revamp
desc: Modernized the Government of India's national student leadership portal into a fast, accessible web app.
problem: India's national PRERANA student program ran on an aging website that was slow on phones and hard for state and district officers to manage.
audience: Students across India applying for the Vadnagar program, plus District & State Education Officers.
impact: Every old government link and bookmark keeps working with zero errors.
Streamlined bulk registration, gender-balanced shortlisting, and top-20 batch selection.
architecture: Migrated legacy PHP workflows to a modular React/Next.js frontend with URL redirect preservation, role-based district/state dashboards, and integrated Anuvadini multilingual support.

tabs.label: Student Portal
tabs.title: 9 Value Themes · Class IX–XII
tabs.description: Experiential residential program in Vadnagar (1888 school) with IIT Gandhinagar curriculum, yoga, maker labs, and student registration.

tabs.label: District & State Admin
tabs.title: Bulk Registration & Shortlisting
tabs.description: Role-based portal for District and State Education Officers to verify applicants, manage gender-balanced shortlisting, and finalize top-20 batches.

tabs.label: Old PHP → React
tabs.title: Modernized Architecture
tabs.description: Replaced legacy server-rendered PHP pages with fast client-side navigation while preserving all existing government URLs and bookmarks.

name: Anuvadini IVR
desc: Built a multilingual Interactive Voice Response (IVR) and real-time speech translation platform for accessible voice communication across Indian languages.
problem: Millions of students and citizens struggle with English-only helplines and web forms, creating a barrier to accessing AICTE and government services over phone calls.
audience: Students, parents, and citizens across India calling educational helplines in regional languages.
impact: Enables real-time regional language voice interaction and automated call routing without needing smartphones.
Supports multilingual ASR, translation, and TTS pipelines for seamless voice-to-voice responses.
architecture: Real-time telephony and web voice pipeline combining Automatic Speech Recognition, Neural Machine Translation, and Text-to-Speech synthesis with low-latency audio streaming.

tabs.label: Voice Pipeline
tabs.title: Multilingual Voice-to-Voice IVR
tabs.description: Real-time speech recognition, neural translation, and natural voice synthesis enabling callers to interact in their native language.

tabs.label: Call Routing
tabs.title: Automated Query Resolution
tabs.description: Intelligent intent detection and dynamic IVR menus that route callers to the right department or answer FAQs automatically.

tabs.label: Language Support
tabs.title: Pan-India Regional Coverage
tabs.description: Designed for low-bandwidth voice calls so users on basic feature phones can access information effortlessly.

name: Anuvadini AI (chatbot)
desc: Engineered the scalable AI chatbot backend powering Anuvadini AI's conversational assistant across official government and institutional portals.
problem: High volumes of student and institution queries across multiple AICTE portals overwhelmed support teams and needed an instant, embeddable AI assistant.
audience: Students, faculty, and institutions visiting AICTE portals, plus internal teams managing knowledge bases.
impact: Powers embeddable AI chat widgets across multiple portals with token-based tenant configuration.
Delivers fast, context-aware answers with multilingual support and centralized API monitoring.
architecture: Multi-tenant backend API serving embeddable chat widgets via hostname-scoped tokens, backed by retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and rate-limited endpoints.

tabs.label: RAG & API
tabs.title: Conversational AI Engine
tabs.description: Processes natural language queries using retrieval-augmented generation to provide accurate answers from official AICTE documents.

tabs.label: Multi-Portal Embed
tabs.title: One-Line Script Integration
tabs.description: Secure hostname-scoped token authentication allowing portals like Prerana and partner sites to embed the assistant.

tabs.label: Scale & Reliability
tabs.title: High-Throughput Query Handling
tabs.description: Optimized request queuing, caching, and structured logging to keep response times fast under peak admission traffic.

name: Subtitle Editor for Video
desc: A web-based subtitle editor for videos with timeline editing, sync controls, and export support.
problem: Editing video subtitles manually in raw SRT/VTT files is error-prone and makes timing adjustments tedious.
audience: Content creators, educators, and localization teams needing fast browser-based caption editing.
impact: Interactive timeline and real-time video preview sync for accurate caption timing.
Clean export workflow supporting standard subtitle formats.
architecture: Client-side React application synchronizing HTML5 video playback timestamps with an editable subtitle cue list and SRT/VTT parser.

tabs.label: Timeline Editor
tabs.title: Frame-Accurate Cue Editing
tabs.description: Edit subtitle text, start/end timestamps, and preview captions directly over the video player in real time.

name: Workforce Tracking System
desc: An employee attendance and workforce management system for tracking tasks, shifts, and productivity.
problem: Manual attendance sheets and scattered task trackers make shift scheduling and productivity monitoring difficult for growing teams.
audience: Team leads, HR managers, and employees tracking daily attendance and assigned tasks.
impact: Centralizes shift tracking, attendance logs, and task assignments in one dashboard.
Reduces manual reporting overhead with clear status visibility.
architecture: Modular web dashboard with role-based views for attendance check-ins, shift rosters, and task progress tracking.

tabs.label: Dashboard
tabs.title: Attendance & Shift Tracking
tabs.description: Manage employee check-ins, shift schedules, and daily task completion from a unified management interface.

name: Object Detection for Blind Individuals
desc: Real-time object detection and audio assistance system built with OpenCV and TensorFlow.
problem: Visually impaired individuals face daily navigation hazards when obstacles in their immediate surroundings go undetected.
audience: Visually impaired users seeking real-time auditory awareness of nearby objects.
impact: Detects everyday objects in real time from camera feeds using TensorFlow and OpenCV.
Converts spatial detections into clear spoken cues for hands-free assistance.
architecture: Real-time video capture pipeline running pre-trained object detection models with audio feedback synthesis.

tabs.label: Detection Model
tabs.title: Real-Time Object Recognition
tabs.description: Identifies surrounding objects from live camera frames and announces them to assist safe navigation.

name: EduVista App
desc: An Android application using WebView components to deliver educational content and multi-feature student tools.
problem: Students needed a lightweight, unified Android app to access educational resources without switching between browser tabs.
audience: Students accessing curated learning portals and study resources on Android devices.
impact: Packages web-based learning modules into a native Android experience.
Provides smooth navigation and quick access to educational tools.
architecture: Native Android wrapper with custom WebView configuration, navigation controls, and offline-friendly error handling.

tabs.label: App Overview
tabs.title: Unified Student Learning App
tabs.description: Delivers responsive educational portals inside a native Android shell with streamlined navigation.
